comment: Catalogue of third-party assets to download with `npm run assets:fetch`.
Downloaded files land in public/assets/vendor/, which is gitignored — the
catalogue is the thing under version control, not the binaries.
Every entry MUST carry accurate licence metadata. `npm run assets:verify`
fails the build if any is missing, and CI runs it on every push.
Good CC0 / permissive sources are listed in docs/ASSETS.md.

assets.description: Rigged, animated fox. Useful for testing skinned-mesh support.
